title: GLM-5.3 hits the API at $1.4/$4.4 per million tokens
summary: On the API, the price is unchanged from GLM-5.2: $1.40 per million input tokens and $4.40 per million output tokens . Cached input costs $0.26 per million tokens, while Z.ai currently lists cached-input storage as free for a limited time.
